package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
)

// scenario for router_setup_runs_migrations: Gin router or handler setup code that also performs migrations.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Product struct {
	ID    int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name  string
	Price float64
}

type Inventory struct {
	ID        int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	ProductID int
	Quantity  int
}

func SetupRouter() http.Handler {
	db, _ := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(":memory:"), &gorm.Config{})
	db.AutoMigrate(&Product{}, &Inventory{})

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/products", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	})
	return mux
}
